name: band-thresholds-come-from-the-template
why: 62.5% against bands set at 0, 50 and 75. Under the canonical instrument's thresholds this is Level 2; under these it is Level 1. The two answers differ, which is the only way to show the engine reads the bands rather than knowing them — and the User's Guide is explicit that countries move these during customisation, so an engine that knew them would be wrong the first time a country did.
